items.quote: Payment is due within 14 days from the invoice date; please quote your student number with the transfer.
items.computation: Start of period: invoice date 5 August 2025 (Tuesday). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (invoice date) is not counted; the 14-day period begins 6 August 2025 and runs 14 days, ending 19 August 2025 (Tuesday). This is a payment to a company, so under § 270 Abs. 4 BGB the payer's own Land (the student's address is in Hamburg) governs any weekend/holiday adjustment under § 193 BGB, but 19 August 2025 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no adjustment is needed.
